market_summary: Late New York session trading is characterized by widespread post-expansion consolidation and volatility compression across all asset classes. Precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD), FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD), and BTCUSD remain structurally bearish beneath their respective session VWAP and EMA50 baselines, yet lack fresh downside volume or CVD impulse as prices hover near session lows or fair-value POCs. US100 retains a technical posture above VWAP but is boxed between Put Wall #1 / Gamma Flip overhead and EMA50 support below. With sub-1.0 RVOL across the board and lack of high-conviction breakout catalysts, all symbols warrant a disciplined HOLD stance.

Action is HOLD.
